headline: PTC (PTC) Rolls Out AI Tools Across ALM And PLM Workflows
summary: PTC (NasdaqGS: PTC) announced new AI-driven capabilities and workflow connectivity features across its ALM portfolio and Arena PLM platform. The updates target engineering efficiency, tighter product data management, and automation across product development workflows. PTC highlighted use cases such as streamlined variant management, regulatory compliance support, and improved supply chain resiliency.
